Sometime prior to [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="KotFE" /> [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]]<ref name="return">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/return|text="Return"|int=Return (cinematic trailer)}}</ref> [[Nico Okarr]] acquired an ancient '''[[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]]''' on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. In a discussion with [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]], Okarr implied that the possession or use of this artifact had enabled him to forestall the effects of aging-mediated decay to some degree and provided him some semblance of artificial longevity. The potency of the artifact's power was such that the Outlander observed that Okarr looked exactly the same in [[3631 BBY]] during the height of the [[Galactic War]]<ref name="KotFE" /> as he had decades earlier.

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Though never explicitly confirmed as such, it is possible this relic was one of those acquired by [[Farel Wickes]] on Korriban and traded to Okarr immediately prior to the events of the [[Return (cinematic trailer)|''Return'']] cinematic trailer.<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> It is implied that Okarr escaped aboard his [[Redshifter|freighter]] with his illegally acquired Sith artifacts in tow after delivering [[Satele Shan]] and [[Jace Malcom]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] following the [[Battle of Korriban]].
